headword: {居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}

definitions.explanation: The space within a home where people live and spend their daily time. Commonly used when discussing home design, floor plans, and comfort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧な{居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}。
⟦{限|かぎ}られた→限る：02033_kagiru⟧{居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: To make effective use of a limited living space.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Because our family grew, we decided to move to a house with more living space.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{居住|きょじゅう}→居住：06812_kyojuu⟧ (residence, dwelling) and ⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧ (space). A somewhat formal and technical term used in architecture, interior design, and real estate contexts. In everyday casual speech, people more often talk about the ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ (rooms), ⟦{間取|まど}り→間取り：06078_madori⟧ (floor plan), or simply the house's ⟦{広|ひろ}さ→広さ：00105_hirosa⟧ (size). {居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん} emphasizes the livable, usable area rather than raw square footage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧な{居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}: a comfortable living space
- ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}: a spacious living area
- {居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to secure living space
- {居住空間|きょじゅうくうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{有効活用|ゆうこうかつよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make effective use of living space

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {住空間|じゅうくうかん}: short form, same meaning
- ⟦リビング→リビング：11198_ribingu⟧: living room — specifically the common area
- ⟦{間取|まど}り→間取り：06078_madori⟧: floor plan, layout of a home
- ⟦{住|す}まい→住まい：11555_sumai⟧: dwelling, residence — more abstract/emotional word for "where one lives"
